name: MIPL CRM/API Integration for Contact Form 7
author: Mulika Team

sections.description:
“MIPL CF7 CRM” is a WordPress plugin that seamlessly connects “Contact Form 7” with any CRM system or REST API endpoint. Automate lead capture, streamline data submission, and eliminate manual data entry with effortless CRM integration.

Features

  1. Universal CRM & API Integration: – Easily connect and submit form data to any CRM or REST API endpoint.

  2. Field Mapping: – Map “Contact Form 7” fields to match your CRM/API structure for accurate data syncing.

  3. Advanced Authentication Methods: – Supports “API key, Bearer Token, Basic Auth, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and OAuth 2.0 + JWT” for secure integration.

  4. Email Notifications: – Get real-time alerts or trigger CRM/API actions based on form submissions.

  5. Leads Management: – Efficiently manage and track leads generated from your website. The plugin helps you organize leads and ensures they are promptly and accurately added to your CRM.

  6. REST API Support: – Leverage modern API-based CRMs for fast and secure data exchange.

  7. Real-time Data Transfer: – Instantly send form submissions to your CRM or API, ensuring no leads are lost.

Pro Features

Upgrade to “MIPL CF7 CRM – Pro” for advanced capabilities:

  1. Built-in CRM Support: – Native integration with “Zapier, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Zoho” for quick setup.

  2. Multiple CRM Integration: – Connect multiple “Contact Form 7” instances to different CRM/API.

  3. Export Leads: – Export leads with form-based filtering for better data management.

With “MIPL CF7 CRM” effortlessly connect/submit your “Contact Form 7” forms to any CRM or API, enhancing lead management and workflow automation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugins folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure form fields: Customize the form to gather the data you need.
  4. Configure the integration: map form fields to CRM fields, and specify CRM lists or segments.
  5. Test the integration: Verify that data from the contact form flows into your CRM correctly.
